criteria.text: The participant is a female of childbearing potential who has not undergone a hysterectomy or bilateral oophorectomy and has not been naturally postmenopausal for at least 12 consecutive months
Local testing of EGFR shows no EGFR exon 19 deletion or EGFR L858 R mutation
Local testing of ALK shows no ALK rearrangement
Local testing of PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (IHC) is performed using one of the following assays: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N or SP263

The participant has completely resected stage IIA, IIB, IIIA or IIIB (T3-4N2) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (squamous or non-squamous) with negative margins (complete R0 resection), staged according to the 8th edition of the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, 2017, and is not known to have N2 disease prior to surgery
The participant has completely recovered from surgery and registration to A081801 occurs 30-77 days following surgery
The participant has had no prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for the current lung cancer diagnosis
The participant has had no prior allogeneic tissue or solid organ transplant

The participant does not have an uncontrolled intercurrent illness including serious ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, or unstable angina pectoris that would limit compliance with study requirements
The participant has no current pneumonitis or history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids
The participant is a human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patient on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months
The participant is age >= 18 years
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) of 0-1
The participant has no active auto-immune disease that has required systemic treatment within the last 2 years
The participant is not pregnant and not nursing, and for women of childbearing potential, a negative pregnancy test done <= 7 days prior to registration is required

The participant has no "currently active" second malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the last 3 years, but participants with non-melanoma skin cancers, low grade or low-risk cancers, or stage I malignancies not requiring systemic therapy, or carcinoma in situ that have undergone potentially curative therapy are eligible
The participant has no hypersensitivity (>= grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients
The participant has received no live vaccine within 30 days prior to registration
The participant has no known hepatitis C virus infection or known history of hepatitis B
The participant has an absolute neutrophil count (ANC) >= 1,500/mm^3
The participant has a platelet count >= 100,000/mm^3
The participant has a hemoglobin >= 8 gm/dl
The participant has a calculated creatinine clearance >= 45 mL/min
The participant has a total bilirubin =< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
The participant has an aspartate aminotransferase (AST) / alanine aminotransferase (ALT) =< 2.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)

P1.text:
A female of childbearing potential is a sexually mature female who:

  * Has not undergone a hysterectomy or bilateral oophorectomy; or
  * Has not been naturally postmenopausal for at least 12 consecutive months (i.e., has had menses at any time in the preceding 12 consecutive months)

P2.text: Local testing of EGFR with no EGFR exon 19 deletion or EGFR L858 R mutation (applicable to non-squamous patients only)

P3.text: Local testing of ALK with no ALK rearrangement (failed testing is considered negative) (applicable to non-squamous patients only)

P4.text: Local testing of PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (IHC) using one of the following assays: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N or SP263

P5.text:
Completely resected stage IIA, IIB IIIA or IIIB (T3-4N2) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (squamous or non-squamous) with negative margins (complete R0 resection). Patients will be staged according to the 8th edition of the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, 2017

  * Note: Patients with pathologic N2 disease, completely resected, are eligible. However, patients known to have N2 disease prior to surgery are not eligible; guidelines do not recommend up-front surgery for this population

P6.text: Complete recovery from surgery. Registration to A081801 must be 30-77 days following surgery

P7.text: No prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for current lung cancer diagnosis

P8.text: No prior allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant

P9.text: Patients must NOT have uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, serious ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, unstable angina pectoris, that would limit compliance with study requirements

P10.text: No current pneumonitis or history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids

P11.text: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial

P13.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS): 0-1

P14.text: No active auto-immune disease that has required systemic treatment within the last 2 years (e.g., disease-modifying agents, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressive drugs). Replacement therapy (e.g., thyroxine, insulin, or physiologic corticosteroid release therapy for adrenal or pituitary insufficiency) is not considered a form of systemic treatment

P15.text:
Not pregnant and not nursing, because this study involves an agent that has known genotoxic, mutagenic and teratogenic effects

  * Therefore, for women of childbearing potential only, a negative pregnancy test done =\< 7 days prior to registration is required

P16.text: No patients with a "currently active" second malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the last 3 years. Participants with non-melanoma skin cancers, low grade or low-risk cancers, or stage I malignancies not requiring systemic therapy (e.g., prostate cancer requiring only observation or superficial bladder cancer), or carcinoma in situ (e.g., breast carcinoma or cervical cancer in situ) that have undergone potentially curative therapy are eligible

P17.text: No hypersensitivity (\>= grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients

P18.text: No live vaccine within 30 days prior to registration. Examples of live vaccines include, but are not limited to, the following: measles, mumps, rubella, varicella/zoster (chicken pox), yellow fever, rabies, Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG), and typhoid vaccine. Seasonal influenza vaccines for injection are generally killed virus vaccines and are allowed; however, intranasal influenza vaccines (e.g., FluMist) are live attenuated vaccines and are not allowed

P19.text: No known hepatitis C virus (defined as HCV ribonucleic acid \[RNA\] \[qualitative\] is detected) infection or known history of hepatitis B (defined as hepatitis B surface antigen \[HBsAg\] reactive)

P24.text: Total bilirubin =\< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)

P25.text: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) / alanine aminotransferase (ALT) =\< 2.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Testing the Addition of a Type of Drug Called Immunotherapy to the Usual Chemotherapy Treatment for Non-small Cell Lung Cancer, an ALCHEMIST Treatment Trial (Chemo-IO [ACCIO])". Your earlier answers already covered 9 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you currently able to become pregnant (i.e., have you had a hysterectomy, removal of both ovaries, or have you been naturally postmenopausal for at least 12 months)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I'm not, sorry.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had your tumor tissue tested for an ALK rearrangement? ALK is a specific gene change in lung cancer cells. If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure, sorry. I think they tested for something like that but I don't know the result.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had your tumor tissue tested for PD-L1 using one of these specific tests: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N, or SP263? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure, sorry. I don't know which specific tests they used.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: When was your last lung cancer surgery? We need to know if it was between 30 and 77 days ago.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm sorry, I haven't had surgery yet. They said they can take it out, but it hasn't happened.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever received a transplant of a solid organ (like a heart, kidney, or liver) or tissue from another person?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any transplants, sorry.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you currently have any serious ongoing infections, or heart conditions like unstable chest pain, heart failure, or irregular heartbeat?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have any serious infections or heart conditions, sorry.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 55, so I am definitely 18 or older. Sorry for the long pause!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have an active autoimmune disease that required systemic treatment (like steroids or immunosuppressants) within the last 2 years? If you aren't sure, that's okay to say.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't needed any medicine like that for an autoimmune disease in the last two years. Sorry for the question!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever had a severe allergic reaction (grade 3 or higher) to pembrolizumab or any of its ingredients?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any reaction to that, sorry. I haven't had any treatment yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you received any live vaccines in the 30 days before you would register for this study? (Live vaccines include things like MMR, varicella, or the nasal flu spray.)

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any live vaccines recently, sorry.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
